note: Seed articles. The daily GitHub Action (scripts/fetch-news.mjs) prepends fresh items from youth-soccer RSS feeds and keeps the mix ~90% youth.

items.title: MLS NEXT announces new clubs and conferences ahead of 2026-27 season
items.summary: MLS NEXT will be represented in 40 states with 318 clubs and over 53,000 players across both divisions as it expands again for 2026-27.

items.title: MLS NEXT announces age-group update, taking effect in 2026-27 season
items.summary: MLS NEXT is moving its Academy Division to a school-year age-group system to align with the broader U.S. youth soccer landscape.

items.title: ECNL Regional League expands and re-aligns with NorCal Premier for 2025-26
items.summary: The ECRL re-aligned into NorCal and Golden State divisions, with ~20 teams per age group qualifying out of NorCal Premier and a promotion pathway to ECNL.

items.title: NorCal Premier announces 25 clubs selected for realigned ECNL Regional League
items.summary: NorCal Premier named the 25 clubs selected for the realigned ECRL NorCal division for the 2025-26 season.

items.title: 2026 Men's DI Recruiting Rankings: March update
items.summary: The latest men's Division I recruiting class rankings, with several prospects opting for the pro route over college.

items.title: 2026 Top 50 MLS Prospects
items.summary: TopDrawerSoccer ranks the top youth-academy prospects on the MLS radar this cycle.

items.title: Cal North: MLS NEXT announces new clubs and conferences for 2026-27
items.summary: Cal North details how Northern California clubs fit into the expanded MLS NEXT footprint for 2026-27.

items.title: ECNL & ECNL Regional League welcome new clubs
items.summary: ECNL and the ECNL Regional League announced new member clubs across the country, including additions on the boys' side.

items.title: 2026 MLS & MLS NEXT Pro signings clarify the youth-to-pro pathway
items.summary: As the pro season opens, homegrown and MLS NEXT Pro signings show how academy graduates make the jump to the professional game.
